_about: GM story hooks. {mentor} {rival} {enemy} {ex} {love} {ally} {friend} {dependent} {sibling} use names generated for this character; 'needs' lists which must exist. Original content written for DCUGen.

hooks.text: {mentor} has vanished, leaving behind a coded note addressed to {name}.
{mentor} asks for one last favor, and it's illegal.
{rival} has gotten powers, and wants a rematch.
{rival} needs {name}'s help, and hates having to ask.
{enemy} has hired someone to dig into {name}'s past.
{enemy} is offering a truce, and the terms are strangely generous.
{enemy} has kidnapped someone close to {name}.
{ex} turns up at {name}'s door, bleeding, with a briefcase handcuffed to one wrist.
{ex} is about to marry someone {name} knows is dangerous.
{love} has started to suspect the truth about {name}'s nights.
{love} has been offered a dream job in another city.
{love} is targeted by someone trying to get to {name}.
{ally} has been arrested, and the charges look manufactured.
{ally} calls with a tip that sounds too good to be true.
{friend} has joined a group that sounds a lot like a cult.
{friend} witnessed something at work and is now being followed.
{dependent} has gone missing on the way home from school.
{dependent} has started showing signs of powers.
{sibling} shows up asking to borrow money, and won't say why.
{sibling} has been accused of a crime {name} is sure they didn't commit.
{sibling} has gone to work for a company with a bad reputation.
A letter arrives in {their} {parent}'s handwriting, postmarked last week.
A stranger at the funeral of someone {name} barely knew says, 'You have their eyes.'
An old photo surfaces showing {name} somewhere {name} has never been.
A documentary crew wants to make a film about the worst day of {name}'s life.
Someone is committing crimes using {name}'s old methods, almost signature by signature.
An anonymous account online is posting details only {name} should know.
A villain has started leaving small, personal gifts on {name}'s doorstep.
{hometown} is being bought up, block by block, by a shell company.
A former classmate from {school} is running for mayor, and knows things.
A hero team has opened a file on {name}, and someone leaked it.
A lost wallet from decades ago is returned, containing a photo {name} has never seen.
A child shows up claiming to be {name}'s kid from the future.
An old debt is being called in by someone who bought it from a dead man.
The police have reopened a cold case with {name}'s name in the file.
A government agency wants {name} to consult on a 'metahuman incident.'
A dying mobster asks to see {name}, and only {name}.
A bar {name} frequents has become neutral ground in a gang war.
Someone has stolen {name}'s identity and is using it to buy weapons.
A villain's henchman wants to defect, and has chosen {name} to defect to.
An insurance investigator is looking very closely at an old claim.
A strange signal on an old radio repeats {name}'s childhood nickname.
A tabloid is preparing a story about {name}'s family secret.
The building {name} grew up in is about to be demolished, and something is hidden in its walls.
A rival hero wants to recruit {name}, and won't take no for an answer.
A plague of minor coincidences suggests someone is manipulating probability around {name}.
A lawyer reads a will that leaves {name} something dangerous.
Someone from the old neighborhood needs a getaway driver, one last time.
